sample_unit: vascular procedures (ChatGPT responses compared with leaflets)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT patient information on vascular procedures versus charity leaflets
links.effect: Mean FKRE 33.3 vs 59.1 for leaflets (p=0.025); FKGL 12.7 vs 9.4 (p=0.002); GFS 16.7 vs 12.8 years; SMOG 12.2 vs 9.4 years.
links.quote: The mean FKRE score was 33.3, compared to 59.1 for the information provided by the Circulation Foundation (SD=14.5, p=0.025) indicating poor readability of AI-generated information.

links.outcome: Reading grade level required for ChatGPT responses compared with patient leaflets
links.effect: FKGL 12.7 for ChatGPT vs 9.4 for leaflets (p=0.002); GFS 16.7 vs 12.8 years; SMOG 12.2 vs 9.4 years.
links.quote: The FFKGL indicated that the expected grade of students likely to read and understand ChatGPT responses was consistently higher than compared to information leaflets at 12.7 vs. 9.4 (SD=1.9, p=0.002).

screen.reason: Evaluates the baseline quality and readability of ChatGPT-generated patient information against human-written leaflets without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
